name: Spirita Battler
detailed_description:
Join our Discord!


About the Game

Welcome to Spirita Battler, an exhilarating online creature battling game that introduces a new era of strategic gameplay. In this unique world, you will:
  • Build Teams: Choose from a wide variety of creatures and their unique abilities. Create the perfect team for you and move forward to victory!

  • Engage in Strategic Battles: With a focus on strategy over chance, every decision counts. Choose your creatures, plan your moves, and adapt to the ever-changing battlefield to outsmart your opponents.

  • Discover unique combinations: Break the game by finding out combinations the developers never intended!

  • Compete in a Global Arena: Challenge players from around the world in intense online battles. Climb the ranks and make your mark on the global leaderboard!

  • Regular Updates and Events: Spirita Battler is continuously evolving, with regular updates bringing new creatures, skills, and challenges to keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.

Are you ready to become a master creature battler? Join Spirita Battler now and carve your path to victory!

short_description: A casual fun multiplayer creature battler. Build your own teams by choosing unique creatures, their skills and special abilities! Develop strategies to better deal against though opponents and climb the ladder to the top!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Celeron G530 2.4Ghz or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GT 650M or similar
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum requirements for playing at 720p@30fps​

Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 10.13 High Sierra or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Comparable to Nvidia GT 650M or similar
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum requirements for playing at 720p@30fps​
